meaning.zh:
“改过自新” 或 “翻开新的一页”。

这个短语源于15世纪，当时书籍的每一页被称为leaf（叶子）。当有人翻过新的页面时，就意味着他们将要开始新的一页、新的章节。在现代，这个短语通常用来表示某人打算做出积极的改变，开始新的习惯或新的生活方式。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the 15th century when each page in a book was referred to as a "leaf." Turning over a new leaf meant starting a new page or a new chapter. In modern usage, it typically means someone is planning to make positive changes, start new habits, or adopt a new lifestyle.

lines.en: After years of bad habits, he decided to *turn over a new leaf* and live healthier.
lines.zh: 多年不良习惯之后，他决定改过自新，过上更健康的生活。

lines.en: She felt it was time to *turn over a new leaf* and focus on her career.
lines.zh: 她觉得是时候翻开新的一页，专注于她的事业了。

lines.en: He promised his family he would *turn over a new leaf* and quit drinking.
lines.zh: 他向家人承诺，他会改过自新，戒酒。
